//: THE EMULATOR SUITE'S PORT TABLE — the one source. Read by emulator-ports.ts (the generator: firebase.json, the dev declaration, the devcontainer) and projected into the owned tools/emulator-ports.mjs (the runtime: emulators.sh, build-seeds.sh, and the stack claim through tools/dev). defaults: firebase-tools' own port per emulator. alwaysOn: infrastructure a running suite always occupies (pinned, shifted, even when firebase.json is silent). nested: ports an emulator opens under a key of its own, with firebase-tools' default for each — occupied, listed and shifted whether or not firebase.json declares them: undeclared, firebase-tools does NOT let them float, it opens its default (a shifted suite's Firestore websocket sat on the base 9150).
